name: Eva
short_zh: 成为一颗龙舌兰，挡住人生的风浪“，我觉得悬崖花园主人阿桑最强大的地方，在于永远相信自己，美好有力量，感染到了更多的人。
short_en: "Become an agave — hold back the storms of life." What stays with me is Asang, host of the cliff garden: she never stops believing in herself. That kind of beauty has force, and it reaches other people.
full_zh: 在涠洲岛的悬崖花园，作为客人只感受到风平浪静的时候，但当我们看到了阿桑种活的一座花园，真是非常佩服。”成为一颗龙舌兰，挡住人生的风浪“，我觉得她最强大的地方，在于永远相信自己，美好有力量，感染到了更多的人。
full_en: At the cliff garden on Weizhou Island, being a guest only feels like calm seas. Then we saw the garden Asang had actually grown into life, and I was genuinely in awe. "Become an agave — hold back the storms of life." I think her greatest strength is that she never stops believing in herself. Beauty has force, and it has reached so many more people.

name: 郝蕊
short_zh: 涠洲岛，最美的风景是人
short_en: On Weizhou, the most beautiful scenery is the people
full_zh:
为什么涠洲岛近年不断被热捧？这次岛上三天所见所得，让人想说那句话“涠洲岛，最美的风景是人”😜

除了帅哥阿亮和小姐姐阿桑，还要感谢只做一桌好饭专门给我们吃的小宸姐，让我们包场环岛咖啡的阿昊，以及默默陪伴的润夏等等。

是你们的坚守、奋斗、热诚和纯善，才终将涠洲岛的美好与珍贵一一呈现。

与你们面对面的交流，让我们的旅程，不仅有美有爱，还拥有真实又独特的故事性。

谢谢！
full_en:
Why has Weizhou been so loved lately? Three days on the island left me wanting to say it out loud: “On Weizhou, the most beautiful scenery is the people.” 😜

Besides Aliang and Asang, thank you to Sister Xiaochen for cooking a table just for us, to Ahao for letting us book out the island café, and to Runxia for quietly walking with us.

Your perseverance, hard work, warmth and kindness are what bring Weizhou’s beauty into view, piece by piece.

Talking face to face with you made our trip not only beautiful and full of care, but also truly and uniquely storied.

Thank you!

name: James R.
short_zh: 组织得极好。沙坝出发的过夜火车是亮点。
short_en: Genuinely one of the best-organised trips I've taken. The overnight train from Sapa was a highlight.
full_zh: 我去过很多地方，但这次路线设计的逻辑感让我印象深刻——它不是简单地把景点串起来，而是真的讲了一个从沿海到高原的故事。夜间米轨火车是意外之喜，在摇晃的卧铺上看窗外的山，整个人都慢下来了。云南段是我个人最喜欢的部分，建水的街道在清晨六点有一种不可思议的安静。
full_en: I've travelled extensively, but the logical design of this itinerary stood out — it doesn't just string sights together, it tells a story from coast to plateau. The overnight metre-gauge train was an unexpected joy. Watching mountains through the window from a swaying bunk, everything slows down. The Yunnan section was my personal favourite — Jianshui's streets at 6am have an uncanny quiet.

name: 林 晓燕
short_zh: 行程安排得非常用心，向导很专业，整个旅途超出预期。
short_en: Thoughtfully arranged, excellent guide — the whole trip exceeded expectations.
full_zh: 我们一家四口第一次尝试跨境自驾游，出发前非常忐忑。但从第一天的接机开始，每个细节都被安排得妥妥当当。越南段的向导小明讲解特别生动，孩子们也很喜欢。德天瀑布那天下了点小雨，竹筏漂流更有感觉。最后在建水住的那家老宅客栈让人印象深刻，早餐的豆腐脑是全程最好吃的一顿。强烈推荐有小孩的家庭！
full_en: Our family of four tried a cross-border journey for the first time — we were nervous before departure. But from the airport pickup on day one, every detail was handled. Our Vietnam guide was incredibly engaging; even the kids loved it. It rained lightly at Detian Falls and the bamboo rafting felt even more atmospheric for it. The old courtyard guesthouse in Jianshui was unforgettable — the tofu soup at breakfast was the best meal of the whole trip. Highly recommended for families.

name: Markus
short_zh: 组织严谨，体验真实。过境出乎意料地顺畅。
short_en: Perfect organisation, authentic experiences. The border crossing was surprisingly smooth.
full_zh: 德国人向来注重行程的严谨性，这次旅行完全符合我的标准，甚至超出了。每天的接送时间精准，没有一次出现混乱。更难得的是，这种高效率背后不失人情味——向导会主动介绍当地风俗，帮我们和村民沟通，让我们感受到了真实的人文温度，而不只是走马观花。下龙湾的日落是我此生见过最美的。
full_en: Germans value precision in travel planning — this trip met my standards completely, and then surpassed them. Every pickup was on time, no confusion ever arose. What made it remarkable was the warmth behind the efficiency — our guide explained local customs, helped us connect with villagers, gave us genuine human warmth rather than just sightseeing. The Ha Long Bay sunset was the most beautiful I've seen in my life.

name: Michelle T.
short_zh: 过境出乎意料地顺利，向导对当地历史的了解令人佩服。
short_en: The border crossing was seamless, and our guide's knowledge of local history was remarkable.
full_zh: 我以为跨境会很麻烦，但向导处理了一切。沙坝的早晨是整个旅程的亮点——我们在迷雾中徒步，感觉就像走进了另一个世界。越南咖啡让我上瘾了，已经在网上找了好几种豆子回来复刻。总体上性价比极高，会推荐给所有想要深度游的朋友。
full_en: I thought the border crossing would be complicated, but the guide handled everything. The Sapa morning was the trip's highlight — trekking through mist felt like stepping into another world. I got addicted to Vietnamese coffee and have been sourcing beans to recreate it at home. Exceptional value overall. I'll recommend this to every friend who wants a deep travel experience.

name: Sarah K.
short_zh: 光是吃就值回票价。向导知道每一处藏着的好店。
short_en: The food experiences alone were worth the trip. Our guide knew every hidden gem.
full_zh: 作为一个美食旅行者，这条路线完全满足了我的期待。每一个城市都有当地向导带我们去「真正的」地方——不是网红餐厅，而是街角的小摊、菜市场、老奶奶家里的灶台。宁平的田螺米线是我从来没有在任何食谱上见过的做法。这趟旅行让我开始认真学越南语了。
full_en: As a food traveller, this route delivered completely. In every city, a local guide took us to the real places — not influencer restaurants, but the street corner stalls, the morning market, the elderly woman's home kitchen. The snail vermicelli in Ninh Bình was prepared in a way I've never seen in any recipe. This trip made me start learning Vietnamese seriously.

name: 【萌娃探中国】团队会员
short_zh: 孩子发自内心的喜欢，就是最好的证明。
short_en: A trip that truly changes your perspective. The Yunnan villages are magnificent.
full_zh: 这是我初次带孩子参加亲子研学营，出发前内心颇多忐忑，既担心形成节奏不适合孩子，也怕旅行只是流于表面的观光。但这趟桂林之行，在小伍大师姐和团队的悉心统筹与全程陪伴下，所有顾虑都彻底打消。行程处处用心，诸多细节都处理得十分妥帖，让人倍感温暖。我想，最好的评价莫过于孩子最真实的反馈。刚刚仔仔很认真的跟我说，妈妈明年我还想来桂林，还想找大师姐。孩子发自内心的喜欢，就是最好的证明。
full_en: The French can be particular about travel quality — but this trip gave me nothing to complain about. Jianshui's streets reminded me of certain towns in southern France, carrying that sense of layered time. The guide took us to a working pottery workshop where I even tried the wheel myself. The French traces in Vietnam also felt strangely familiar — those old cafés and streets recalled a history I'd half-forgotten.
